get.description: Everything the inspector shows for one asset, with its parent product's fields.
An asset's thumbnail, from the thumbnail cache next to the database.
Manual and smart collections with their member counts.

schema.title: Response Get Collections Api V1 Collections Get

post.description: A manual collection, or a smart one (a saved search); new_uid is its uid.
Set a field on one asset or many (bulk edit); a null value reverts to the scanned one.
Add or remove tags on one asset or many.
Forget the user's choice about one tag (back to what scans found).
Put assets into a product, or (parent null) take them out of any product.
The same asset found twice: `uid`'s entries and children join `into`.
`uid` becomes a variant of `into`: one asset, two variants.
Entries wrongly grouped into an asset become an asset of their own (new_uid).
A variant becomes its own asset again (new_uid).
A new product (new_uid) holding assets and/or a desk folder's unattached files.
Link files (or a desk folder's unattached files) onto an asset.
Mark assets as not assets (out of Unidentified and default views), or count them again.
Ignore a folder from now on: its unattached files leave the desk, and rescans skip it.
Add assets to a manual collection, or (present false) remove them.

get.description: Every lexicon as scans use it: the file's terms, plus the words scans found (known authors).

schema.title: Response Get Lexicons Api V1 Lexicons Get

post.description:
Add a word to a lexicon term (written to the user's lexicon file), or remove it. Applies on the
next rescan or classification.

get.description: Pending suggestions, one page at a time, with counts by kind.

post.description: Accept suggestions in one undoable step (the desk's batches).
Reject suggestions: they are not offered again.

get.description: Online roots, the desk's top level for unattached files (counts come per folder).

schema.title: Response Desk Roots Api V1 Desk Roots Get

get.description: One folder level of a root's unattached files: subfolders with counts, and files directly in it.
Unattached files under a folder (all levels).

schema.title: Response Desk Files Api V1 Desk Files Get

get.description: The library's edits, newest first (every session's, the window's included).

schema.title: Response History Api V1 History Get

post.description: Undo one history entry, from any session; the undo is itself undoable.

get.description: What Undo and Redo would do now.

post.description: Undo this session's latest edit (label null when there is none).

get.description: What editors offer: dossier types, the category tags, and the editable fields.
